target: Derive a formal or quantitative account of distributed trials using a federated trial manifest. Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.

competency.title: Derive distributed trials — distribution shift
competency.outcome: Derive a formal or quantitative account of distributed trials using a federated trial manifest. Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.
competency.practice_task: Produce a stepwise derivation with units or invariants grounded in a federated trial manifest.
competency.setting_constraint: Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.
required_evidence: a stepwise derivation with units or invariants
Include shift definition and in/out-distribution results.
Report reproducible merges and conflict resolution with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: mixing incomparable hardware results.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of distributed trials.
Practice: the derivation reproduces a checked special case.
Measurement: report reproducible merges and conflict resolution against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for mixing incomparable hardware results; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
